SELECT sum(h.ssh_prnamt) AS answer, list(DISTINCT h.accession_number) AS accession_number FROM holdings h JOIN filings f USING (accession_number) WHERE h.cusip IN ('67066G104') AND f.fund_name = 'Renaissance Technologies LLC' AND f.report_quarter = '2026Q1' AND h.put_call IS NULL
LIMIT 1000
